/* [서식간 규칙] 등록 - insertRule */ INSERT INTO ocuoc_bzcrr_l (RULE_ID, RULE_NM, CMPR_TYP_CD, WK_ID, RGSR_ID, REG_DT) VALUES (#{rule.ruleId}, #{rule.ruleNm}, #{rule.cmprTypCd}, #{rule.wkId}, #{userId}, SYSTIMESTAMP)

mapper.sql: SELECT R.RULE_ID AS ruleId, R.WK_ID AS wkId, R.RULE_NM AS ruleNm, R.CMPR_TYP_CD AS cmprTypCd, R.CUR_VER AS curVer, R.USE_YN AS useYn, V.DEF_JSON AS defJson, R.RGSR_ID AS rgsrId, TO_CHAR(R.REG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS regDt, R.EDTR_ID AS edtrId, TO_CHAR(R.CHNG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS chngDt FROM ocuoc_bzcrr_l R JOIN ocuoc_bzcrv_l V ON V.RULE_ID = R.RULE_ID AND V.RULE_VER = R.CUR_VER
mapper.insert: /* [서식간 규칙] 역할 설정 저장 - mergeRole */ MERGE INTO ocuoc_ocrwr_l T USING (SELECT #{role.wkId} AS WK_ID, #{role.formId} AS LEFRM_ID, #{role.roleNm} AS ROLE_NM FROM dual) S ON (T.WK_ID = S.WK_ID AND T.LEFRM_ID = S.LEFRM_ID AND T.ROLE_NM = S.ROLE_NM) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET T.ROLE_MTHD_CD = #{role.methodCd}, T.FILD_KEY = #{role.fieldKey, jdbcType=VARCHAR} WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (WK_ID, LEFRM_ID, ROLE_NM, ROLE_MTHD_CD, FILD_KEY, RGSR_ID, REG_DT) VALUES (S.WK_ID, S.LEFRM_ID, S.ROLE_NM, #{role.methodCd}, #{role.fieldKey, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{userId}, SYSTIMESTAMP)
mapper.delete: /* [서식간 규칙] 역할 설정 삭제 - deleteRole */ DELETE FROM ocuoc_ocrwr_l WHERE WK_ID = #{wkId} AND LEFRM_ID = #{formId} AND ROLE_NM = #{roleNm}
